description: Change of use of the existing two storey rear building from a scuba diving pool centre (Class E) to a coffee roastery (Class B2) with the installation of a chimney flue and erection of a detached waste/ recycling and cycle storage unit within the site's internal courtyard.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  A2.1D  Received:  28 March 2024;  A1.1B; A1.2; A1.3; A1.4C; A2.2C  Received:  22 March 2024;  A1.5; A1.6; Unreferenced Location Plan  Received:  05 January 2024.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 3 - All delivery, waste collection and servicing vehicles relating to the coffee roastery and shop site shall park within the designated loading bays of the site's private inner courtyard only and not park on the public highway at any time.

Condition : 4 - The existing two storey rear building's external rear fire escape staircase shall be used for emergency fire escape purposes only and not for any other purpose, such as general access or employee amenity.

Condition : 5 - Waste (including organic food waste) and recyclable materials relating to the coffee roastery and shop uses shall be stored within the designated Waste/ Recycling and Cycle Storage Unit only and not stored on the public highway at any time.

Condition : 6 - A minimum of four employee Sheffield stand cycle parking spaces shall be provided within the detached waste/ recycling and cycle storage outbuilding, located in the site's inner courtyard hereby approved, and be permanently retained as such.  

The proposed detached waste/ recycling and cycle storage outbuilding shall be constructed with brick walls to match the site's existing buildings.

Condition : 7 - All proposed coffee roasting, processing and related air filtration plant installed and operated within the rear building as hereby approved shall not generate noise exceeding a volume of ten decibels below background noise levels as measured from within the nearest residential properties to the site at any time and be permanently retained as such.  All necessary mitigation measures including wall insulation and damping platforms shall be installed prior to the commencement of the industrial process to ensure compliance with these requirements.

Condition : 8 - All elements of the air filtration plant described within the submitted Emissions Report, including the cyclone filtration plant, clean air catalytic purifier and fuel dilution system, shall be installed prior to the commencement of coffee roasting and processing operations, correctly operated at all times and permanently retained as such.  Regular maintenance of this installed air filtration plant shall be undertaken to achieve best operational performance.
